description: Waste and recycling — Resource Recovery Centre locations is a dataset listed in Brisbane City Council open data portal (data.brisbane.qld.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Brisbane City Council. Information about Brisbane City Council's resource recovery centres, including name, address, opening hours, latitude and longitude. Resource recovery centres are Brisbane City Council’s four waste and recycling facilities (formerly known as transfer stations or tips) located in Willawong, Chandler, Ferny Grove and Nudgee. Coverage: Brisbane, Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Brisbane City Council. Its tags are composting, recovery, recycling, resource, waste. It offers 3 resource(s) in csv, json, geojson. The portal shows 2026-08-26 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-brisbane-qld-gov-au-portal.
